title: Shadow traffic policy: control-plane schema, validation, and migrations
creator: Talia Benson
project: Shadow traffic tool for eval metrics
description:
Context
- We’re adding “shadow traffic” (mirrored requests) as a first-class capability in routing + rollouts. This ticket covers the control-plane policy schema, config validation rules, and migration support so routing components can consume a stable, versioned contract.
- The schema must work across Hosted/Dedicated/Private and compose with existing RoutePolicy + Rollout/Experiment objects.

Goals
- Define a versioned, forward-compatible ShadowTrafficPolicy schema in the control plane.
- Implement strict validation to prevent unsafe or high-overhead configurations (tail latency impact, telemetry cardinality blowups, excessive fanout).
- Provide migration scaffolding so existing route configs can be updated without breaking older agents/binaries (fail-open defaults).

Non-goals
- Implement runtime mirroring in the data plane (ENG-5402).
- Implement deterministic bucketing hash function or request fingerprint plumbing (ENG-5403), but schema must reference the bucketing mode + salt source.
- Implement redaction/retention pipeline (ENG-5411), but schema must expose knobs for what metadata can be captured/emitted.

Proposed schema (v1)
Placement
- Route object: route.policy.shadowTraffic (optional)
- Rollout/Experiment object: may reference or override route.policy.shadowTraffic (see validation notes).

Fields (conceptual)
- enabled: boolean (default false)
- sampling:
  - mode: "bernoulli" | "consistent_hash" (default "consistent_hash")
  - rate_ppm: integer [0..1_000_000] (sampling rate in parts-per-million; default 0)
  - bucket_key: "request_fingerprint" | "user_id" | "session_id" (default "request_fingerprint")
  - hash_salt_ref: string reference to per-tenant secret (required when mode=consistent_hash)
- targets: list of shadow targets (min 1 when enabled; max 3)
  - target_id: string (stable identifier, used in telemetry)
  - variant_ref: reference to existing variant (model version / quantization profile / routing policy) (required)
  - request_timeout_ms: integer [50..2000] (default 400)
  - max_stream_capture_ms: integer [0..2000] (default 250; 0 means capture disabled)
- request_types: list of "chat" | "completions" | "embeddings" | "rerank" (default ["chat","completions"]; embeddings/rerank must be explicitly enabled)
- headers:
  - mode: "strip_all" | "allowlist" (default "allowlist")
  - allowlist: list of header names (default: minimal set: trace headers + request-id; must reject wildcard patterns)
- metadata_capture:
  - capture_prompt_ref: boolean (default true for Hosted/Dedicated, false for Private unless explicitly enabled)
  - capture_tool_calls: boolean (default true)
  - capture_retrieval_context: boolean (default false)
  - prompt_truncation_chars: integer [0..20000] (default 2000; 0 disables capture)
- fail_open:
  - on_shadow_target_error: "drop" | "retry_async" (default "drop")
  - on_shadow_pipeline_unhealthy: "drop" (v1 only)
- guardrails:
  - max_fanout_per_request: integer [1..3] (default 1)
  - max_shadow_qps_percent_of_route: integer [1..25] (default 5)
  - circuit_breaker:
    - open_on_target_error_rate_pct: integer [1..50] (default 10)
    - open_on_p99_shadow_latency_ms: integer [100..5000] (default 1500)
    - half_open_after_seconds: integer [10..600] (default 60)

Validation rules (server-side)
Hard validation failures (reject config)
- enabled=true requires:
  - sampling.rate_ppm > 0
  - targets length in [1..3]
  - each target.target_id unique, <= 64 chars, [a-zA-Z0-9._-] only
  - each target.variant_ref resolves to a valid variant in the same tenant and compatible request_types
  - max_fanout_per_request <= targets length
- sampling.mode=consistent_hash requires hash_salt_ref
- sampling.rate_ppm must be <= 250_000 (25%) for v1 unless tenant has allowlisted override (Dedicated/Private can request via support)
- request_timeout_ms must be <= 2000 and >= 50
- headers.mode=allowlist requires allowlist size <= 24; header names normalized and validated; reject "authorization", "cookie", "x-api-key" unless explicitly permitted by tenant security settings
- prompt_truncation_chars must be <= 20000; if capture_prompt_ref=true and prompt_truncation_chars=0 => reject (ambiguous)
- request_types may not include embeddings/rerank for streaming routes (guard against accidental “mirror everything” on high-QPS embedding endpoints)

Soft validation (warn + store) / Console warnings
- If sampling.rate_ppm > 50_000 (5%) show “high cost/overhead risk” warning.
- If targets > 1 warn about fanout and scoring pipeline capacity.
- If capture_retrieval_context=true warn about retention/redaction and potentially large payloads.

Migration / compatibility plan
- Add new optional field route.policy.shadowTraffic with default disabled.
- Control-plane serialization should be backward compatible: older agents ignore unknown fields.
- Introduce schema version tag for shadowTraffic: shadowTraffic.schema_version = "v1".
- Add migration hook for existing route configs:
  - If route has legacy “mirror” debug flag (internal) translate to shadowTraffic.enabled=true with sampling.rate_ppm=1000 (0.1%) and target derived from legacy field; mark as “migrated_from=legacy_mirror”.
  - Otherwise, no-op.
- Include config expansion step in policy compilation so data plane receives a fully-materialized form (defaults applied, warnings emitted) while preserving original authored config for audit.

Testing / rollout
- Unit tests for validation (table-driven): sampling bounds, target uniqueness, header allowlist restrictions, incompatible variant refs, max fanout.
- Migration tests: legacy -> v1 translation; no changes when not present.
- Add JSON schema + OpenAPI contract update for policy service.
- Rollout behind feature flag: shadow_traffic_policy_schema_v1 (control plane) to allow safe staged enablement.

Links
- ADR: adr-shadow-traffic-routing-architecture (Confluence)
- ADR: adr-shadow-metrics-data-model-and-cardinality (Confluence)
- Slack: #eng-platform thread “shadow-traffic-policy-fields”
- GitHub: redwood/pr-24810-add-shadow-traffic-policy-schema

Acceptance criteria
- [x] Control plane accepts and persists shadowTraffic policy on routes.
- [x] Server-side validation rejects unsafe configs per rules above with actionable error messages.
- [x] Defaults applied deterministically and reflected in compiled policy payload.
- [x] Migration scaffolding present and covered by tests.
- [x] Changelog entry + internal docs snippet for policy fields and constraints.

Implementation notes (final)
- Landed as “ShadowTrafficPolicyV1” in control-plane config package; policy compiler emits a compact compiled struct for data plane.
- Validation implemented in policy-service layer, not in Console, to ensure enforcement across APIs/SDKs.
- Header allowlist validation uses canonical lower-case comparison; rejects wildcard patterns and whitespace.
- Added tenant capability gate for sampling > 25% and for allowing sensitive headers.
comments:
2025-12-03 — Talia Benson (creator)
Created from Shadow Traffic Phase 0 plan. Priority P0 because routing work (ENG-5402) needs a stable policy contract to proceed. Please keep the schema minimal for v1; we can add richer knobs once we have telemetry + scoring in place.
2025-12-06 — Benji Okafor (assignee)
Drafted schema proposal. Open questions:
1) sampling units: percent vs ppm — proposing ppm to avoid float + UI can render percent.
2) where to attach: route only vs rollout override. I’m leaning route.policy.shadowTraffic with optional rollout override, but validation must prevent conflicts.
3) header propagation: default allowlist (trace headers only) to reduce risk.
Requesting review from Ethan/Jordan/Ravi.
2025-12-10 — Jordan Lee
+1 on ppm + consistent hashing default. For bucketing key, please keep it to request_fingerprint for v1; adding user/session IDs touches privacy + requires upstream guarantees. If we include the field, validate it’s not used unless tenant capability is enabled.
2025-12-12 — Ravi Menon
Routing side needs explicit per-target timeout_ms + max fanout. Also, please ensure the policy compiler materializes defaults so the data plane doesn’t need to guess. For streaming: capture semantics should be a separate ticket, but we should at least have max_stream_capture_ms and enforce sane bounds.
2025-12-18 — Marcus Lin (Security)
Please reject allowlisting sensitive headers by default (Authorization/Cookie/X-API-Key). If we need them for debugging in Private, gate behind explicit tenant setting + audit log. Also: capture_prompt_ref default should be false for Private unless customer opts in.
2026-01-07 — Benji Okafor
Implemented schema + validation in feature branch. Added tenant capability gates:
- allow_sampling_over_25_percent
- allow_sensitive_headers
- allow_non_fingerprint_bucket_key
Next: migration scaffolding (legacy mirror flag) and tests.
2026-01-14 — Benji Okafor
Opened PR redwood/pr-24810-add-shadow-traffic-policy-schema. Includes:
- ShadowTrafficPolicyV1 model + JSON schema
- validation errors with field paths
- policy compiler default materialization
- 42 validation unit tests + 6 migration tests
Pending review from Ethan + SRE for guardrail thresholds.
2026-01-18 — Sean Gallagher (SRE)
Guardrails look reasonable. Request: enforce a hard cap of 3 targets in control plane (you did). Also add warning for sampling > 5% (Console can surface). Please ensure validation rejects timeout_ms > 2s (helps avoid resource pinning under backpressure).
2026-01-21 — Ethan Park
Reviewed PR. Main feedback: make schema_version explicit ("v1") and ensure older agents ignore shadowTraffic (they will). Also, migration from legacy mirror should be best-effort and must not flip enabled=true if the legacy target ref can’t be resolved.
2026-01-27 — Benji Okafor
Addressed review feedback:
- Added schema_version field
- Migration is now no-op unless legacy target resolves; otherwise emits warning and leaves disabled.
- Tightened error messages for header allowlist.
2026-02-03 — Benji Okafor
PR merged. Feature flag remains off by default. Follow-ups filed for Console validation parity and for streaming capture semantics in data plane.
2026-02-12 — Talia Benson
Marking Done. This unblocks ENG-5402/5403 integration work. Please ensure we include this in the beta enablement checklist (feature flag + tenant capability gates) so support isn’t surprised.
